title: Chronic kidney disease: stage, hypertension and dialysis status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's kidney disease and any related hypertension and dialysis status.
note:
Chief Complaint
Routine follow-up for end stage renal disease.

HPI
The patient presents today for scheduled follow-up related to their end stage renal disease. They report their maintenance hemodialysis treatments have been going well without any acute changes since the last visit. They also report managing their blood pressure at home, noting no significant changes in their hypertension management. They continue to adhere to the prescribed regimen for their hypertension.

Medication List
Maintenance hemodialysis treatments; Antihypertensive agent.

Exam
Vitals are stable. Physical exam is unremarkable, with no signs of acute distress noted today. Peripheral pulses are 2+ bilaterally.

Assessment
1. End stage renal disease requiring maintenance hemodialysis.
2. Hypertension, currently managed.

Plan
Continue maintenance hemodialysis as scheduled. Continue current antihypertensive regimen for HTN management. Follow up as needed.
explanations: Hypertension with CKD stage 5 or ESRD: I12.0, plus N18.5/N18.6.
ESRD: N18.6. If a stage and ESRD are both documented, assign N18.6 only.
Patient on dialysis: add Z99.2 dependence on renal dialysis.

distractors.why: I12.9 is for stage 1-4 or unspecified CKD.
The classification presumes a link between hypertension and CKD.
Assign N18.6 only when ESRD is documented.
Dialysis status is reported with Z99.2.
